description: This file contains extension methods for the RequestContext class, providing functionality to import and export context data, and retrieve reentrancy IDs from message context data within the Orleans runtime.

classes.name: RequestContextExtensions
classes.description: Provides extension methods for handling RequestContext data, including importing, exporting, and retrieving reentrancy identifiers.

methods.name: Import
methods.description: Imports provided context data into the current RequestContext, replacing any existing values.

methods.name: Export
methods.description: Exports a copy of the current RequestContext data using a DeepCopier.

methods.name: GetReentrancyId
methods.description: Retrieves the reentrancy ID (Guid) from a Message or context data.
